resources.string: Xs is an independent, unofficial browser feasibility build. X pages connect normally to X and WebView stores the web session. No Xs history capture, web bridge or filters are active. Login and media compatibility still need real-device testing. Local data is not a backup and may be lost on uninstall.

Internal W0 PoC. Automatic capture off; manual local post-link saving is available. Direct login, 2FA, Google, Apple and Passkey are separate pending checks. Downloads open externally; popups, camera and microphone are unsupported.
Xs will create a private local folder for saved post links. This is not an X login or verified account, and it does not capture browsing automatically. Content may be lost if the app is removed.
